name: Portrait Stats Hero
description: Split hero: outline badge, display heading, intro, paired CTAs and a trusted-by logo row on the left; a portrait photo card with a radial brand glow and two floating stat tiles (count-up number + delta, rating with star) on the right.
interactions: stat tiles rise in (translateY 16px -> 0, 600ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), 120ms stagger) at 30% viewport via IntersectionObserver
numbers count up once over 900ms with cubic ease-out (80K, 4.9 with one decimal)
primary CTA hover/active follow design-system button states at 120ms; light CTA gains soft-300 shadow on hover
prefers-reduced-motion: tiles render in place, numbers set instantly
